analysis: Chlorpropamide is known to treat both diabetes mellitus and diabetes insipidus. It is a sulfonylurea class drug primarily used for type 2 diabetes mellitus, but it also has an antidiuretic effect that can be beneficial in treating diabetes insipidus.
